name: BEN_BILL_CHARGES
description: BEN_BILL_CHARGE contains information related to Master charge record for each month and Stores summary amounts.

columns.name: BILL_CHARGE_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key column.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: This column indicates the Foreign Key to PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F.

columns.name: BILLING_DATE
columns.description: This column indicates the bill generation date.

columns.name: HOLD_BILL_FLAG
columns.description: This column indicates that hold bill flag is set Y or N.

columns.name: TOTAL_BILL_AMT
columns.description: This column indicates the total outstanding bill amount which is the summation of CURRENT_BILL_AMT, PAST_AMT_DUE, OTHER_AMT_DUE.

columns.name: BILL_YEAR
columns.description: This column indicates the year of bill generation which flows from BEN_BILL_CALENDAR.

columns.name: BILL_PERIOD
columns.description: This column indicates the billing period which flows from BEN_BILL_CALENDAR.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: This column indicates the billing status for which the possible values are Open, Unpaid, Partially-paid, and Fully-paid.

columns.name: BILL_CAL_ID
columns.description: This column indicates the Foreign Key to BEN_BILL_CALENDAR.

columns.name: BILL_SOURCE
columns.description: This column determines if bill was generated manually or by batch process.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: This column indicates the comments which flows from BEN_BILL_CALENDAR.

columns.name: BILL_GENERATED
columns.description: This column indicates that the bill is generated or not. It holds Y or N as value.

columns.name: BILL_GENERATED_DATE
columns.description: This column indicates the date on which bill was generated.

columns.name: PAST_AMT_DUE
columns.description: This column holds past due amount. From prior yet Unpaid, Partially-paid bill details / line items.

columns.name: BILL_NUM
columns.description: This column indicates the Generated ID, could be PK as well.

columns.name: BILL_REASON
columns.description: This column is created for Future use.

columns.name: OTHER_AMT_DUE
columns.description: This column holds amount values from conversion.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: This column indicates currency code as on program or plan.

columns.name: PER_ACCT_NUM
columns.description: This column indicates the Foreign Key to PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F.

columns.name: CURRENT_BILL_AMT
columns.description: This column indicates the holds bill for current period.

columns.name: TOTAL_TAX_AMT
columns.description: This column indicates total tax amount. This column is created for Future use.

columns.name: PER_BILL_INFO_ID
columns.description: This column indicates the Foreign Key to BEN_PER_BILL_INFO_F.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.
